R1-reopen: reopen exact project and compare IDs, custom data, ranges
R1-duplicate: DuplicateTimeline to VERA 141 R1 identity; compare both timelines
R1-trim: trim a separate labeled linked occurrence by 25 frames
R1-move: move a separate labeled linked occurrence 25 frames later
R1-razor: blade a separate labeled linked occurrence at local frame 100
R1-copy: copy/paste one linked piece at a nonoverlapping location
R1-repeat: save/reopen repeat and second named duplicate
R2-linked-cut: remove frames 60–70 on linked V1/A1
R2-unlinked-cut: unlink and remove interval on A1 only
R2-picture-only: remove interval on V1 only
R2-partial: remove only frames 65–70 on A1
R2-residual-track: enable A2 repeated-speech occurrence
R2-disable-mute: compare enabled/disabled, mute/solo, routing and output
R2-offset: shift unlinked A1 one frame without changing source bounds
R2-retime: set linked clip to 50% and capture source map
R2-derived-end: compare subframe/source-time values to exact sample support
R3-opaque: enable V2 and inspect frames 49, 50, 99, 100
R3-transparent: enable V3 and inspect overlap and return frames
R3-effect: apply identified effect and record settings/viewer result
R3-disabled: disable cutaway and overlay separately
R3-offline: use R4 unlink probe and inspect present offline occurrence
R3-merge-graphic: blade V1/A1 under enabled V3; keep Graphic distinct
R3-boundary: blade base A/V at frame 100, then A3 crossing bed
R3-visibility interpretation: bound claims to inspected frames/effects
